questions2.question2: What do you usually use your laptop for?

questions2_answer.question2: I usually use my laptop for work, studying, and entertainment. I browse the internet, watch videos, do research, and sometimes play games or connect with friends online.

questions3.question3_1: Do you often watch movies on your laptop or go to the theater?
questions3.question3_2: I used to work on a laptop and it stopped and I lost all my notes. Tell me about a bad time with your computer?
questions3.question3_3: Technological improvements have made our lives easier. what do you think?

questions3_answer.question3_1_answer: I prefer watching movies in the theater because of the large screen and immersive sound. However, I do watch movies on my laptop when I want convenience and comfort at home.
questions3_answer.question3_2_answer: Once, my laptop crashed while I was working on an important project, and I lost all my notes. It was incredibly frustrating, but I learned to back up my data regularly afterward.
questions3_answer.question3_3_answer: Technological improvements have certainly made life much easier and more efficient. With advanced tools, we can communicate faster, work more effectively, and access information instantly from anywhere in the world.

questions4_main: Dear member, members often post on the website's club. But lately there’s been a few negatives on the other member's post. We are thinking of changing the website to identify anyone who makes a comment. Please give your opinion to fix the situation.
question4_1_text: Write a short email to your friend (about 50 words).
question4_2_text: Write an email to the president of the club (about 120-150 words).
question4_1_text_answer:
Hi Linh,
I just heard that the club is considering identifying users who post comments on the website. I think this is a good idea to prevent negativity and ensure more respectful interactions.
Let me know your thoughts!
Best,
Phuong
question4_2_text_answer:
Dear Club President,
I am aware of the negative comments on the club’s website recently, and I believe implementing a system that identifies users posting comments is a great idea to address the issue. This could help reduce disrespectful behavior and foster a more positive atmosphere within the club.
Additionally, I suggest we introduce guidelines for posting comments, encouraging members to express their opinions constructively. It may also help to appoint moderators to monitor content and ensure compliance.
I’m happy to assist in developing or enforcing these changes and believe that with these improvements, the club’s website will be a more welcoming and supportive space for all members.
Best regards,
Jimmy
